params.body:
Accounts (gentells.com) and Team (Observatory and Studio access) were two lists of the same people, with different controls on different pages. They are now one page, **People**, under System.

**One list**
- People are joined by email address. Each row shows the plan on gentells.com (with "(team)", a trial or "blocked"), Observatory access (Admin, Member, Removed or none, plus "invited, not accepted"), reads in the last 30 days, last seen and newsletter status.
- The team comes first, then the rest by name. A line counts the people and the team.

**A panel per person instead of "More" and loose buttons**
- A click on a row opens a panel under it, with one labelled line per thing you can change:
  - **Plan:** a segmented choice. It is fixed while someone is on the team.
  - **Trial:** None, 7, 14 or 30 days.
  - **Account:** Active or Blocked.
  - **Observatory and Studio:** Member or Admin, remove from or put back on the team, send the invitation again; for someone not on the team, an invitation.
- **Add someone to the team** sits next to the search.
- Every action says in one line what happened.

**Navigation**
- System holds Pipeline, Analytics, **People** and Settings.
- `/team` leads to People.
- Settings keeps Machine and Plans; the read-only access key moves to Machine.

Checked: build, lint at its ceiling, e2e 28 passing (the panel changes a plan).
params.title: People: the site accounts and the team in one list, changed in a panel per person
